usage: Discord server banner behind the server name. Dark, text-free, high energy, key content in the lower two thirds, darker upper third for Discord's overlay.
status: APPROVED: banner_victory_night generation from 2026-07-30 is the locked style anchor for the whole brand. Regenerate only for resolution or crop needs; keep everything else identical.

variants.prompt: A wide cozy living room at night at the exact second of a game victory, seen from behind a big couch, three friends as dark silhouettes leaping and throwing arms up, one controller mid-air, popcorn scattering above the couch, the large screen erupting in a bright abstract victory burst of cyan and white shapes (#6ec3d9), warm amber fairy lights strung along the wall (#e0a458), open pizza box and toppled popcorn bowl on the low table, a startled cat mid-jump off the armrest, record player and plants in the warm shadows, flat vector illustration with subtle paper grain, deep charcoal navy palette (#14161f), loud with joy, no text, no faces, darker upper third for overlay

A dark hallway leading to a door ajar at the far end, an intense warm party glow (#e0a458) and flickering cyan game-light (#6ec3d9) bursting through the gap, a few confetti flecks drifting out into the hallway, sneakers kicked off in a happy pile by the door, a doormat askew, the light on the hallway floor shaped like a long welcoming wedge, flat vector illustration with subtle paper grain, near-black charcoal navy palette (#14161f), the room beyond is clearly mid-celebration, no text, no people

notes: The party_door alternate is a spare, not for the server banner slot. It was drawn for the charter card, which no longer exists.
Server banners require boost level 2 to display on Discord; keep the file ready regardless.
